method: Read the current official MOM pages with web access; frozen fixtures remain unchanged.

sources.ordinaryRule: Provide the payslip with payment; if unable, within three working days of payment.
sources.terminationQuote: In the case of termination or dismissal, must give pay slip together with outstanding salary.
sources.interpretation: The termination/dismissal requirement must be visible alongside, and distinguished from, the ordinary fallback. Do not infer an independent three-working-day extension after outstanding salary is paid.

sources.summary: Final-salary payment dates differ: resignation with required notice is payable on the last employment day; without notice, within seven days of that day. Employer termination or misconduct dismissal requires payment on the last employment day, or within three working days if that is not possible.
sources.limitations: Payment timing does not determine the amount owed. Ordinary salary and overtime payment periods are distinct; foreign-employee tax clearance is a separate obligation.
